import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source data
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Inspect columns in source0:
    # ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever',
    #  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']

    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]

    # Transformation plan:
    # - Group by user_id
    # - Aggregate sad.depressed and open.stressed by mean (to get a float value per user)
    # - Rename sad.depressed -> sad, open.stressed -> stressed
    # - Ensure user_id is int, sad and stressed are floats

    # Group by user_id and aggregate mean of sad.depressed and open.stressed
    agg_df = df_source0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })

    # Rename columns to target schema
    agg_df.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)

    # Enforce data types
    agg_df['user_id'] = agg_df['user_id'].astype(int)
    agg_df['sad'] = agg_df['sad'].astype(float)
    agg_df['stressed'] = agg_df['stressed'].astype(float)

    # Save to target CSV
    agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
